name: Robinson, Ivers/Aivers, and Finch Foundations
description:
Even before the days of recorded history, humanity has sought to build upon the world around them, and architecture is one such example of humanity's expression through creation. By taking abstract concepts and ideas and turning them into reality, they build every structure with a purpose; laying bricks as both a feat of science and a work of art. But RIFF/RAFF recognizes that regardless of their architectural ingenuity, humanity's effect on the material universe is fleeting. Entire cultures and civilizations come and go as the stars spin, and the ruins of their vast empires inevitably erode and crumble to dust. For this reason, RIFF/RAFF strives not to protect humanity's physical creations, but the techniques, elements, and styles with which the countless cultures throughout the Milky Way's Orion Arm build their ephemeral legacies.

The corporation began as a Union database of blueprints, records, and accounts of cultural architecture from old Cradle known as The Architectural Elements, Styles, and Techniques of the Milky Way's Orion Arm Before Union, populated with information collected from Massif Vault and various surviving cultures. The database was assembled by a small team of three historical preservationists, and they managed to collect an astonishing amount of information. As it grew, its three creators repeatedly requested more and more personnel for the project, and eventually, it branched into its own Union company entirely. When General Massive Systems developed the first mechs in 4500u, Union sent the company to follow suit. They developed mechs based on the architectural styles in the database as a way to generate public interest in the preservation of such techniques, which then became tools for traveling across the Diaspora to discover and record more.
